artifact_observations.reasoning: The title text 'TERRIFIC TWO' is mirrored/reversed and slightly distorted. The character's feet do not make solid contact with the surface; they appear to float slightly or merge with the background line work. The ground plane lines are inconsistent with the perspective of the title block.
